directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 40 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Electric 40 is the worked example here. See /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and 23 MPa. If 45 kW is available, this page stays on the shortlist. 380 V itself is printed on B500S-83D, not on every electric page. The exception to cite is B500S-83D, which prints 380 V on its own page. The electric hub runs from B500S-83D and Electric 10 through Electric 80 and the HBT80 pages. Electric 40 is 45 kW, output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone distance 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 distance 40 m / 120 m, hopper 0.4 m³, weight 2300 kg. The section title “Number of poles, frequencies and synchronous induction motor speed” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是现场有电网时，先打开邢台的电动泵页面的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。电动40只是这里的例子。如果 45 kW 供得上，这一页留在短名单里。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa。380 V 印在 B500S-83D 上，不是每一张电动页都有。可以单独引用的例外是 B500S-83D，它在自己的页面印了 380 V。电动分类从 B500S-83D 和电动10一直到电动80和 HBT80 页面。见 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/。电动40是 45 kW、输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa，细石距离 120 m / 360 m，13 骨料距离 40 m / 120 m，料斗 0.4 m³，重量 2300 kg。节标题「数的极, 频率与同步 induction 电机 转速」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

question.en: Does “Number of poles, frequencies and synchronous induction motor speed” replace Electric 40 is the worked example here?

answer.en: No. Electric 40 is the worked example here remains the printed wording for Electric 40 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。电动40只是这里的例子。仍是现场有电网时，先打开邢台的电动泵页面已印的说法。

question.en: Where does See /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ belong on the Electric 40 Concrete Pump row?

answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。
